question: In September 2021, ______ became the first IAS officer to win a medal at the Paralympics.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Suhas Yathiraj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Suhas Yathiraj** is a **District Magistrate **of Gautam Buddh Nagar, Noida, Uttar Pradesh.

 
 
• He represents India in **Badminton sports**.
 
• He has won a **Silver Medal in Paralympics 2021**.
 
• He has completed his graduation as a computer engineer from NIT Karnataka.
 
• As of August 2022, his **current world ranking is 2**.
 
 
 
• Paralympics 2021 was held in **Tokyo, Japan**.
 
• **Maskot** for 2021 Paralympic was **Someity**.
 
• **India won 19 medals in all, including 5 gold, 8 silver and 6 bronze.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nishad Kumar** is an athlete who represents India in **High Jump**.
 
• **Devendra Jhajharia** is a** Javelin Thrower** and has won **two gold medals** for India in the Paralympics.
 
• **Singaraja Adhana** is an Indian **shooter **and has won a **bronze medal **in **10m air pistol **in the 2020 summer Paralympics.
